title.tr: MUBA Vault sürekliliği otomatik hale geldi
title.zh: MUBA Vault 连续性实现自动化

text.en: After every main update, a dedicated workflow now validates Telegram regressions, the public website and canonical History before synchronizing the passive Vault and creating a new ZIP plus SHA256 export.
text.tr: Her main güncellemesinden sonra özel workflow önce Telegram regression testlerini, web sitesini ve canonical History'yi doğruluyor; ardından pasif Vault'ı otomatik güncelliyor ve yeni ZIP + SHA256 export'u üretiyor.
text.zh: 每次 main 更新后，专用 workflow 会先验证 Telegram 回归测试、公开网站和 canonical History，再同步被动 Vault，并生成新的 ZIP 与 SHA256 导出。
text.ar: بعد كل تحديث لـ main يتحقق workflow مخصص أولاً من اختبارات Telegram والموقع العام وCanonical History، ثم يزامن Vault السلبي وينشئ ZIP وSHA256 جديدين.
text.hi: हर main update के बाद dedicated workflow पहले Telegram regressions, public website और canonical History validate करता है; फिर passive Vault sync करके नया ZIP + SHA256 export बनाता है।

title.en: MUBA Continuity unified the project history
title.zh: MUBA Continuity 统一了项目历史
title.hi: MUBA Continuity ने project history को एक किया

text.en: Website Development Log, Assistant Updates and MUBA Daily now read the same append-only history source, with continuity checks for future user-facing changes.
text.tr: Website Development Log, Assistant Yenilikleri ve MUBA Daily artık aynı silinmeyen geçmiş kaynağını kullanıyor; gelecekteki kullanıcıya dokunan değişiklikler için süreklilik kontrolleri eklendi.
text.zh: Website Development Log、Assistant Updates 与 MUBA Daily 现在读取同一个只追加历史源，并为未来面向用户的变更加入连续性检查。
text.ar: أصبح Website Development Log وAssistant Updates وMUBA Daily يقرؤون من مصدر تاريخ واحد لا تُحذف سجلاته، مع فحوص استمرارية للتغييرات المستقبلية التي تمس المستخدم.
text.hi: Website Development Log, Assistant Updates और MUBA Daily अब एक ही append-only history source पढ़ते हैं, और future user-facing changes के लिए continuity checks जोड़े गए हैं।

title.zh: MUBA Gallery 新增 DEV 管理
title.ar: أضيفت إدارة DEV إلى MUBA Gallery
title.hi: MUBA Gallery में DEV moderation जोड़ा गया

text.en: Gallery creations can now be kept public, hidden or rejected by DEV without deleting the archive record.
text.tr: Galeri üretimleri artık arşiv kaydı silinmeden DEV tarafından yayında, gizli veya reddedilmiş durumda tutulabiliyor.
text.zh: Gallery 作品现在可由 DEV 设为公开、隐藏或拒绝，同时保留归档记录。
text.ar: يمكن لـ DEV الآن إبقاء أعمال Gallery عامة أو مخفية أو مرفوضة دون حذف سجل الأرشيف.
text.hi: Gallery creations अब archive record हटाए बिना DEV द्वारा public, hidden या rejected रखी जा सकती हैं।

title.tr: MUBA çalışma durumu kalıcı depolama farkındalığı kazandı
title.zh: MUBA 运行状态支持持久化存储识别
title.ar: أصبحت حالة تشغيل MUBA واعية بالتخزين الدائم

text.en: When persistent storage is available, Assistant read-state and Guardian history can now use it automatically instead of relying only on memory.
text.tr: Kalıcı depolama mevcut olduğunda Assistant okundu durumu ve Guardian geçmişi artık yalnız belleğe bağlı kalmadan bunu otomatik kullanabiliyor.
text.zh: 当持久化存储可用时，Assistant 已读状态和 Guardian 历史现在会自动使用它，而不再只依赖内存。
text.ar: عند توفر تخزين دائم يمكن الآن لحالة القراءة في Assistant وسجل Guardian استخدامه تلقائياً بدلاً من الاعتماد على الذاكرة فقط.
text.hi: Persistent storage उपलब्ध होने पर Assistant read-state और Guardian history अब केवल memory पर निर्भर रहने के बजाय उसे automatically इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं।

title.en: MUBA Gallery became the community visual archive
title.tr: MUBA Galeri topluluk görsel arşivi oldu
title.zh: MUBA Gallery 成为社区视觉档案
title.ar: أصبحت MUBA Gallery أرشيف المجتمع البصري
title.hi: MUBA Gallery community visual archive बना

text.en: Successful creations from Web Studio and Telegram Studio now flow into one shared MUBA Gallery with format, source and short visual labels.
text.tr: Web Studio ve Telegram Studio'da başarıyla üretilen görseller artık format, kaynak ve kısa görsel etiketleriyle ortak MUBA Galeri'ye akıyor.
text.zh: Web Studio 与 Telegram Studio 成功生成的作品现在统一进入 MUBA Gallery，并显示格式、来源和简短视觉标签。
text.ar: تنتقل الآن الإبداعات الناجحة من Web Studio وTelegram Studio إلى MUBA Gallery مشتركة مع النوع والمصدر ووصف بصري قصير.
text.hi: Web Studio और Telegram Studio की successful creations अब format, source और short visual labels के साथ shared MUBA Gallery में आती हैं।

title.zh: Studio 各格式更加清晰区分

text.en: Meme, Image, Sticker and Reaction now use distinct visual guidance, with stronger realistic emotion direction for MUBA reactions.
text.tr: Meme, Image, Sticker ve Reaction artık farklı görsel yönlendirmeler kullanıyor; MUBA reaksiyonlarında daha güçlü ve gerçekçi duygu yönlendirmesi var.
text.zh: Meme、Image、Sticker 与 Reaction 现在使用不同的视觉指导，并强化 MUBA reaction 的真实情绪表达。
text.ar: تستخدم Meme وImage وSticker وReaction الآن توجيهاً بصرياً مختلفاً مع تعبيرات أكثر واقعية في ردود MUBA.
text.hi: Meme, Image, Sticker और Reaction अब distinct visual guidance इस्तेमाल करते हैं, और MUBA reactions में realistic emotion direction मजबूत है।

title.hi: Studio default रूप से text-free हुआ

text.en: Studio creates text-free visuals by default and allows visible writing only when explicitly requested.
text.tr: Studio varsayılan olarak yazısız görsel üretiyor; görünür yazı yalnız açıkça istendiğinde ekleniyor.
text.zh: Studio 默认生成无文字视觉，仅在用户明确要求时加入可见文字。
text.ar: ينشئ Studio صوراً بلا نص افتراضياً ولا يضيف كتابة مرئية إلا بطلب صريح.
text.hi: Studio default रूप से text-free visuals बनाता है; visible writing केवल explicit request पर आती है।

text.en: The website gained direct Studio generation, preview, download and MUBA TWT handoff.
text.tr: Web sitesine doğrudan Studio üretimi, önizleme, indirme ve MUBA TWT'ye geçiş eklendi.
text.zh: 网站新增直接 Studio 生成、预览、下载以及进入 MUBA TWT 的流程。
text.ar: أضيف إلى الموقع إنشاء Studio المباشر والمعاينة والتنزيل والانتقال إلى MUBA TWT.
text.hi: Website में direct Studio generation, preview, download और MUBA TWT handoff जोड़ा गया।

title.en: The website became a living MUBA hub
title.tr: Web sitesi yaşayan MUBA merkezine dönüştü
title.zh: 网站成为动态 MUBA 中心

text.en: The fixed information page evolved into a development log, expandable knowledge hub, Studio gateway and MUBA TWT sharing desk.
text.tr: Sabit bilgi sayfası; Development Log, genişleyebilir Knowledge Hub, Studio geçidi ve MUBA TWT paylaşım alanına dönüştü.
text.zh: 固定信息页面升级为开发日志、可扩展知识中心、Studio 入口和 MUBA TWT 分享区域。
text.ar: تحولت صفحة المعلومات الثابتة إلى سجل تطوير ومركز معرفة قابل للتوسع وبوابة Studio ومساحة مشاركة MUBA TWT.
text.hi: Fixed information page Development Log, expandable Knowledge Hub, Studio gateway और MUBA TWT sharing desk में विकसित हुई।

title.en: MUBA Assistant became a deeper MUBA space
title.tr: MUBA Assistant daha derin bir MUBA alanına dönüştü
title.zh: MUBA Assistant 成为更深入的 MUBA 空间
title.ar: أصبح MUBA Assistant مساحة أعمق لـ MUBA
title.hi: MUBA Assistant एक deeper MUBA space बना

text.en: Story Mode, Community Guide, topic context, Development Log and CREATE → SHARE expanded the private Assistant beyond simple question-and-answer.
text.tr: Story Mode, Community Guide, konu bağlamı, Development Log ve ÜRET → PAYLAŞ; özel Assistant'ı basit soru-cevap yapısının ötesine taşıdı.
text.zh: Story Mode、Community Guide、主题上下文、Development Log 与 CREATE → SHARE 让私聊 Assistant 超越简单问答。
text.ar: وسّعت Story Mode وCommunity Guide وسياق الموضوع وDevelopment Log وCREATE → SHARE دور Assistant الخاص إلى ما بعد السؤال والجواب.
text.hi: Story Mode, Community Guide, topic context, Development Log और CREATE → SHARE ने private Assistant को simple Q&A से आगे बढ़ाया।

text.en: Real community violations can be recorded and reviewed by category while ordinary successful DEV controls stay quiet.
text.tr: Gerçek topluluk ihlalleri kategori bazında kaydedilip incelenebiliyor; başarılı normal DEV işlemleri sessiz kalıyor.
text.zh: 真实社区违规可按类别记录和查看，正常成功的 DEV 控制保持安静。
text.ar: يمكن تسجيل مخالفات المجتمع الحقيقية ومراجعتها حسب الفئة بينما تبقى أوامر DEV العادية الناجحة هادئة.
text.hi: Real community violations category के हिसाब से record/review हो सकते हैं, जबकि successful normal DEV controls silent रहते हैं।

title.zh: Guardian START / STOP 行为已同步
title.ar: تمت مزامنة سلوك Guardian START / STOP
title.hi: Guardian START / STOP behavior synchronized हुआ

text.en: PAUSED now means runtime protection is actually paused, and START restores protection while DEV controls remain available.
text.tr: PAUSED artık çalışma korumasının gerçekten durduğu anlamına geliyor; START korumayı geri getirirken DEV kontrolleri kullanılabilir kalıyor.
text.zh: PAUSED 现在真正暂停运行时保护，START 会恢复保护，同时 DEV 控制仍可使用。
text.ar: أصبح PAUSED يوقف الحماية فعلياً ويعيد START الحماية مع بقاء أوامر DEV متاحة.
text.hi: PAUSED अब runtime protection को सच में रोकता है और START protection वापस लाता है, जबकि DEV controls available रहते हैं।
